scoring_justification: T1 recompute is infeasible because the verifier sandbox cannot recompute DFT band gaps or IPR from raw wavefunctions. T2 consistency is not applicable as no richer raw artifact is available. Hence T3 structural trends are scored.

outputs.description: Computed band gaps (eV) at Γ for stoichiometric and oxygen-deficient a-ITO. A hidden verifier will assess the structural impact of oxygen deficiency.
Average inverse participation ratio near the valence and conduction band edges for stoichiometric and oxygen-deficient a-ITO. A hidden verifier will assess the structural impact of oxygen deficiency.

output_contract.notes: The structural impact of oxygen deficiency on the electronic structure is assessed.

steps.description: Verify band gap narrowing: stoichiometric_gap_ev > oxygen_deficient_gap_ev

Verify enhanced localization near VBE (oxygen_deficient_avg_ipr_vbe > stoichiometric_avg_ipr_vbe) and that CBE states are less localized than VBE states (stoichiometric_avg_ipr_cbe < stoichiometric_avg_ipr_vbe and oxygen_deficient_avg_ipr_cbe < oxygen_deficient_avg_ipr_vbe).
